value: Femdom game with branching scenarios, contains a dedicated shrinking branch, as well as optional scenarios when using a shrinking spell. Most of the female lines have voice acting.

You are on the school’s public morals committee, trying to crack down on delinquent behaviour. In an effort to win the spot of committee chairman over your sadistic rival Victoria, you are tasked to solve issues raised by students and report your achievements. Each task involves confronting sadistic girls, who will not hesitate to put you in your place should you lose in battle.
